title: Power of the Fifth Page
next_chapter_hook: That chess piece hung suspended, yet Chen Ji's choice had already made the entire board tremble—burn the future for a chance at present life, or wager the key to destiny on the distant Chapter 700?

text.content: Cang Yutian's black piece hovered mid-air, and three thousand six hundred patterns blazed across the board—that was the death prophecy's predestined eye of Chapter 700—Chen Ji had witnessed that scene himself, countless times seeing himself perish at that point in midnight dreams.

"Give up." Cang Yutian's voice was cold as the Nine Nether Abyss, "The power of the Fifth Page of the Tianji Record, you think I don't know you've already unsealed it? Every fragment has its price, the Fifth Page's price... is the collapse of the timeline itself. Each time you use it, one possibility vanishes from fate."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not answer. His consciousness sank deep into the Tianji Record, and the complete information of the Fifth Page flooded his mind like a tide—a power capable of rewriting any destined fate, yet also a double-edged sword.

text.content: Fifth Page · Destiny's Quill: The holder may select any thread of fate and, at the cost of their own Heavenly Fate Value, forcibly rewrite its outcome. Each rewriting causes an irreversible collapse of a small portion of the timeline—those erased possibilities will never reappear.

Chen Ji suddenly smiled. That smile was bitter and self-mocking, as if mocking his own calculations over the years, and also mocking fate's cruel joke. He raised his head, directly facing Cang Yutian's unfathomable eyes.

dialogue.content: "If I use the Fifth Page now, to rewrite the death ending of Chapter 700..." His voice was soft, yet each word was crystal clear. "All possibilities after Chapter 701 will vanish with the timeline's collapse. Including Chen Nian, including Qingyao, including all the chess games I have yet to complete."

text.content: Cang Yutian's hand hesitated for an instant when placing his piece. Chen Ji caught that subtle change—he knew he was right. What Cang Yutian wanted wasn't to kill him, but to force him to personally destroy his own future.

dialogue.content: "The death prophecy of Chapter 700 is the end point of my eight years of scheming across the world, and also the starting point." Chen Ji rose slowly, the black piece warming in his palm. "If I use the Fifth Page prematurely here, what I lose at that moment isn't just one chance to rewrite—it is all possibilities after Chapter 700."

text.content: His Heavenly Fate Value was now only thirty-seven points. The Fifth Page required twenty points for one rewrite, leaving seventeen points which would be insufficient to support any complete fate foresight. Chen Nian's whereabouts, Qingyao's crisis, even Ling Yuan's ultimate scheme—all required him to maintain sufficient Heavenly Fate Value to foresee in advance.

Cang Yutian's piece finally fell. A blinding golden light erupted from the board's center—that was the node where fate threads converged, and also the position where Chen Ji had seen himself die in countless visions.

choice.prompt: The golden light on the board stung Chen Ji's brow center painfully, and his Heavenly Fate Value was draining rapidly. Should he burn the Fifth Page's power now to rewrite this game, or... restrain himself, keeping the key to destiny for the truly irreversible moment?

choices.description: Immediately use the Fifth Page to rewrite the current fate line, forcibly turn the tide at the cost of twenty Heavenly Fate Value. The price is losing the capital to rewrite Chapter 700's ending, and this branch of possibilities will forever vanish from the timeline.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the ultimate trump card to rewrite Chapter 700
choices.visible_reward: Current game victory, Cang Yutian's scheme falls through
choices.risk_hint: All schemes after Chapter 700 will vanish due to timeline collapse, including Chen Nian's whereabouts

text.content: Chen Ji's right hand shot forward, brilliant golden light blooming between his five fingers. The Fifth Page of the Tianji Record quivered violently in the depths of his consciousness—a pain close to tearing apart—as if countless possible versions of himself were dissipating in the river of time.

dialogue.content: "Rewrite." He uttered two words, his voice hoarse as if scraped from the depths of his throat. The golden light on the board twisted abruptly, and Cang Yutian's black piece was forcibly lifted by an invisible force, deviating three inches from the predestined eye.

choices.text: Endure it with his body, preserve the trump card
choices.description: Abandon rewriting the current situation, allow Cang Yutian's piece to strike the predestined eye. Bear the backlash from the premature triggering of the death prophecy, but preserve the Fifth Page's power for Chapter 700.
choices.visible_cost: Bear the backlash of the predestined eye, injuries worsen
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the ultimate trump card to rewrite Chapter 700
choices.risk_hint: Current game ends in defeat, potentially triggering Cang Yutian's follow-up lethal moves

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his hand. He closed his eyes, letting the black stone fall into the Eye of Fate. The moment the golden light exploded, he felt a cold force seep along the chessboard patterns into his meridians—a premonition of death's prophecy coming true ahead of schedule.

dialogue.content: A strand of blood trickled from the corner of his lips. He opened his eyes, his gaze terrifyingly calm. "Cang Yutian." he said softly, "You've won this round. But at Chapter Seven Hundred... I'll be waiting for you there."

choices.text: Counter-checkmate, transferring the Eye of Fate
choices.description: Instead of directly using the Fifth Page to rewrite, utilize its power to transfer the Eye of Fate's curse to another target. Highest risk but preserves trump cards.
choices.visible_cost: Consume fifteen Heavenly Fate points, and may expose the existence of the Fifth Page
choices.visible_reward: Eye of Fate transferred to Cang Yutian himself
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may have prepared countermeasures; failed transfer will result in double backlash

text.content: A fierce gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. His fingers traced the edge of the chessboard gently. The power of the Fifth Page of the Tianji Record was not used for rewriting, but transformed into a诡异的符文, spreading along the chessboard patterns toward Cang Yutian.

dialogue.content: "The Eye of Fate, chooses its master to devour." His voice was hoarse like a night owl. "Cang Yutian, since you want me to die under my own Eye of Fate, then perhaps... you should taste its flavor first?"

text.content: Cang Yutian's expression finally changed. The speed at which that uncanny rune spread along the chessboard patterns far exceeded his expectations. More terrifying was the aura of that rune... it was precisely the Eye of Fate of the death prophecy!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his lips, and a faint smile appeared on his pale face. That smile carried the relief of surviving a catastrophe, as well as deep mockery toward fate.

text.content: "I'll keep the Fifth Page's rewrite opportunity for you." he said word by word. "But the Eye of Fate... I've accepted it on your behalf. Cang Yutian, see you at Chapter Seven Hundred."

The golden light on the chessboard faded slowly, but Chen Ji knew this was merely the calm before the storm. Cang Yutian would not let this go, and the chess game of Chapter Seven Hundred... had just begun laying its first piece.

choice.prompt: The chess game paused temporarily, but undercurrents surged. Though Cang Yutian suffered backlash from the Eye of Fate, his foundation is deep; one transfer may not completely suppress him. Chen Ji needs to decide his next course of action.

choices.description: Utilize Cang Yutian's wounded state, ally with Su Qingyao and others for full attack, secure victory before he recovers. High risk but high reward.
choices.visible_cost: May expose all our trump cards, and our own condition hasn't recovered
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may have hidden hands; reckless attack may fall into a trap

text.content: Chen Ji gestured toward the shadows. Su Qingyao's figure flickered out like a specter from the darkness, the clear chime of her sword leaving its sheath echoing through the entire chess room. Cang Yutian's expression changed abruptly—he hadn't expected Chen Ji to have埋伏 an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow here.

choices.text: Take the profit and retreat, strategic withdrawal
choices.description: This exchange has achieved advantage; retreat proactively while Cang Yutian is wounded, preserve strength for future plans. Safe but may miss the opportunity to expand gains.
choices.visible_cost: Cang Yutian will have time to plan revenge
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, trump cards not revealed
choices.risk_hint: If Cang Yutian recovers from this, the troubles will be endless

text.content: Chen Ji slightly shook his head, signaling Su Qingyao not to act rashly. Although Cang Yutian was wounded, the forces behind him were deeply entrenched. If they pressed the advantage now, they would only fall into an even greater trap. He clasped his hands toward Cang Yutian in salute, then turned and left.

choices.text: Coercion and temptation, recruiting Cang Yutian
choices.description: Using the Fate-Determining Eye as leverage, negotiate with Cang Yutian to test if he can be recruited. High risk, high reward.
choices.visible_cost: If negotiation fails, it will completely enrage Cang Yutian
choices.visible_reward: If successful, can gain a powerful ally
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian has a mysterious identity, likely with unspeakable secrets

text.content: Chen Ji stopped in his tracks, turning back to look at Cang Yutian. "How does the Fate-Determining Eye feel?" His voice was calm. "I can help you break free from it, but you must tell me... who is the person behind you."

Cang Yutian was silent for a long while. The backlash from the Fate-Determining Eye crawled through his meridians like a venomous snake, each heartbeat bringing searing agony. He raised his head, for the first time examining this "waste" before him with serious eyes.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji..." His voice was hoarse. "You are more difficult to deal with than I anticipated. But do you think this means you've won?" He suddenly smiled, that smile carrying an inexplicable meaning. "In the chess game of Chapter Seven Hundred, I am merely the outermost piece. The one truly holding the pieces... you haven't met yet."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Cang Yutian's words were like a bucket of cold water poured over his heart—the outermost piece? Then who was the chess player? Was it Ling Yuan? The Holy Sect? Or that existence he never dared to think about—the Heavenly Eye?

At this moment, a faint tremor came from deep within the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke faintly from the first page: "You used the power of the fifth page too early. The real test... is still to come."

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes. The power of the fifth page had been mostly consumed, but the true chess game had just begun. Cang Yutian's words were like a thorn in his heart—chess player, chess player... could it be that all his layouts over the years were merely a piece on someone else's chessboard?

He thought of the despair in Chen Nian's eyes when she was taken away, of Qingyao's lonely silhouette practicing sword under the moonlight, of his own death that he kept seeing in his visions. All the schemes, all the endurance, all the sacrifices... were they all designed from the start?

choice.prompt: Chen Ji stood alone in the chess room, Cang Yutian had vanished into the night. He felt an unprecedented exhaustion—not just physical, but spiritual. The power of the fifth page of the Tianji Record had revealed a terrifying truth: he had been playing chess against fate, yet he didn't know if he himself was merely a piece on the board.

choices.description: Su Qingyao is the only one who noticed Chen Ji's abnormality, perhaps he can reveal part of the truth to her and gain emotional support.
choices.visible_cost: May expose more of his trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's trust and support
choices.risk_hint: Although Su Qingyao is trustworthy, she is backed by the Tianqing Sect, and her stance may not be completely aligned

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao had been waiting in the shadows. Seeing Chen Ji stumble out of the chess room, she stepped forward quickly and gripped his arm. "You're injured." Her voice carried a hint of urgency she had never shown before. "What do you need me to do?"

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶开始深入了解陈机

choices.text: Search for Mo Xiansheng alone to seek answers
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng is the remnant soul guardian left by Chen Xuan, perhaps he knows more about the Tianji Record and the true chess player.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger Mo Xiansheng's unsealing conditions
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng only speaks what he deems necessary each time, never revealing the complete truth easily

text.content: Chen Ji returned to his dwelling and immersed his consciousness into the first page of the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sat cross-legged within the void, surrounded by faint starlight. Sensing Chen Ji's arrival, he slowly opened his eyes.

choices.description: Ye Qing is a Holy Sect saintess; her demonic path mist can conceal the Tianji Record's aura. Perhaps she knows something about the 'Chess Player.'
choices.visible_cost: May Deepen Entanglement with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Intelligence Support from the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: Although Ye Qing has become an ally, her identity is sensitive; contact must be extremely cautious

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's figure materialized from the black mist, her eyes carrying a hint of surprise. 'Already here so soon?' Her voice was low. 'It seems your troubles are greater than I imagined.'

text.content: Su Qingyao's fingers gently traced the bloodstain on Chen Ji's cheek, her movements tender—unlike her usual demeanor. Chen Ji did not pull away; he simply stared quietly into her eyes.

'Chen Ji.' Su Qingyao's voice was soft. 'What exactly are you carrying? Why does every time I look at you, it feel like watching someone who might vanish at any moment?' Her brow furrowed—that was an expression he had never seen on her—worry, not accusation.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji opened his mouth, yet found himself unable to speak. Over these years, he had grown accustomed to bearing everything alone, never considering confiding in anyone. But at this moment, seeing the worry in Su Qingyao's eyes, he suddenly felt an indescribable exhaustion.

text.content: Moonlight poured through the window lattice, illuminating Chen Ji's pale and weary face. He suddenly gave a faint smile—that smile carried a touch of self-mockery, and also a vulnerability he had never revealed before. 'Qingyao... if one day I'm gone, help me take care of Chen Nian.'

Su Qingyao's body froze rigid. She stared fixedly into Chen Ji's eyes, as if trying to see something in those deep pupils. After a moment, she suddenly grabbed Chen Ji's collar and pulled him toward herself.

dialogue.content: 'You listen to me.' Su Qingyao's voice was low and firm, her eyes slightly reddening. 'You are not allowed to die before me. The Tianji Record, the prophecy of fate—none of that, I, Su Qingyao, believe in such nonsense. You dare to die, and I dare to drag your soul back from King Yama's hall.'

text.content: Chen Ji stared at her in a daze. At this moment, the aloof and iron-willed Inner Disciple Senior Fellow was gone; before him stood only a woman afraid of losing him. He suddenly felt a warmth spreading somewhere in his chest, as if something soft had touched him.

'Alright.' He answered softly, his voice hoarse and barely audible. 'I'll try my best.' This was the first time he had made such a promise to anyone. Although he knew that on fate's chessboard, this promise might be fragile and easily shattered—at least for now, he was willing to believe.

Night wind blew through the window, carrying a chill. Chen Ji watched Su Qingyao's departing figure, his heart filled with mixed emotions. The truth revealed on the fifth page of the Tianji Record pressed against his heart like a massive boulder—if he truly was a piece in the Chess Player's game, then what meaning did all his schemes hold? Chen Nian's sacrifice, Qingyao's waiting, these years of endurance... were all these within someone else's calculations?

However, he could not retreat. Even if he was merely a piece, he would be the one capable of overturning the entire board. Cang Yutian said in Chapter Seven Hundred that he was only the outermost piece on the board—then who was the Chess Player? Was it Ling Yuan? The existence behind the Holy Sect? Or the one he had never dared to contemplate... the Eye of Heavenly Providence?

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, pressing these thoughts into the deepest recesses of his heart. What mattered most now was recovering his strength and facing the challenges ahead. As for the Chess Player... someday, he would personally drag them out from the board. This game, he would not lose.

That piece hung suspended, undecided, yet Chen Ji's choice had already begun to tremble the entire chessboard—whether to burn through the future in exchange for survival in this moment, or to wager fate's key on the distant Chapter Seven Hundred? Whichever path he chose, he had already taken that step. And the gears of fate, at this very moment, began to turn quietly, moving steadily toward that destined ending.
